name: Obscenity Man
source:
Age: unknown
Likes: rule of force
Skill: superhuman fighting through the use of admin rights
Role: rank C admin

A mysterious man who stands in the way of the Judgement 7 as they are trying to escape from the New World. Because he hides his face using digital mosaic, [url=/c62009]Owari[/url] gave him the name "Obscenity Man". In addition to his face, his voice also has effects added to it, so his true identity is a complete mystery. He uses "admin rights" that can interfere with the rules of nature of the New World and is also in control of his underlings, the men in black suits.

[Translated from [url=http://oreowa.jp/character/obscenityman.html]the official site[/url]]
